resolution: Inspected the live Moped selection without mutating it. The selected UV islands are 333 and 334 in rearIndicator.wall. Island 333 contains four render triangles forming two equal quads and has 3D area about 0.00208 square metres; island 334 contains two triangles forming one quad and has area about 0.00104 square metres. Therefore the islands are not the same physical size: 333 is exactly twice the surface area. Each individual quad within 333 is the same size as the single quad in 334. Their current UV coverage is approximately 360 versus 216 pixels squared, only a 1.667 ratio rather than the physical 2.0 ratio.
